commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Caught. On a good length, pitching near leg stump and angled across the batter. Asalanka pushes forward and sweeps, but is caught by Rutherford
FOUR! Good length, pitching outside off. Chase gets forward and outside edges back behind point for 4 runs.
Good length from Simmonds, outside off stump. Jeremiah gets on the back foot and drives behind point on the off side for 1 run.
Good line and length. Chase gets forward, and is hit on the pads while trying to play a sweep
FOUR! Good length from Sams, outside off stump once again. Chase moves onto the front foot and drives through the off side field for 4 runs.
MAXIMUM! Back of a length from van Schalkwyk, outside off stump but angled across Green. He moves onto the back foot and pulls for 6 runs behind square.

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Caught. On a good length, outside off stump. Clarke moves onto the back foot and edges, and is caught by Asalanka behind point.

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! van Schalkwyk gets the wicket! Full, outside off stump. Rutherford gets forward and plays a shaky drive, and is caught by Auguste on the off side.
FOUR MORE! Pitched up, pitching outside off once again. King rocks back and slices a square cut for four runs.

DROPPED! Length ball, pitching outside leg stump and angled across de Kock. He rocks back and outside edges for a pair of runs back behind square. A chance for a catch, but it's dropped by Forde. A really tough chance for Forde there.
